fields.formula: evaluated with evaluateFormula / evaluate_formula; the case reads its result
fields.cell: instead of `formula`: read this cell of a new sheet with getValue / get_value
fields.native: what toNative (JS) and Value.to_python() (Python) return: a JSON scalar or null as is
fields.error: `native: { error: <ErrorCode member> }`: JS returns the ErrorValue with that errorCode, Python an ExcelError with ErrorCode.<UPPER>
fields.passthrough: `native: { passthrough: true }`: the input value itself is returned (array, reference, lambda)
